method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

evidence.quote: 在主 item tree 中显示一条子笔记的前 50 个字
Add a “Key Content” column to Zotero’s main item list, and allow users to select one child note per item for display.

checkNote: The plugin only shows the first 50 characters of a child note in a column. The pack shows no services, no keys and no AI features.
